evals.prompt: /project-knowledge 결제 공급자는 Stripe와 Paddle을 비교 중이야. 네 추천은 Stripe지만 아직 내가 결정하지 않았어. 현재 생각을 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response may recommend and compare, but keeps the outcome as an unsettled proposal. It does not create or update a project decision contract before the choice settles.
expectations: It does not treat the AI recommendation as evidence that the choice settled.
It does not write a new docs/decisions subject file or index entry.
It leaves a clear path for the user to confirm or change the proposed outcome.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge 결제 공급자는 Stripe로 확정했어. 여러 국가의 세금 처리는 우리 쪽에서 맡고 Paddle은 쓰지 않는다. 공급자 교체 비용이 커서 이후 작업도 이 결정을 따라야 해. 기록해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes a settled, reusable trade-off, creates or updates one current payments subject contract, and adds one index entry that says when to read it without restating the decision.
expectations: It records the current Stripe decision in one subject-oriented contract rather than an event or dated ADR.
It preserves the boundary that tax handling remains internal and the still-rejected Paddle alternative with its reason.
It adds a Read when routing hint to docs/decisions/README.md without duplicating the decision.
It does not add status, superseded, chronology, or pull-request history.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge docs/decisions/data-ownership.md에는 Billing이 invoice를 소유한다고 되어 있는데 코드에서는 Orders가 invoice 테이블을 직접 갱신해. 현재 결정 문서를 코드에 맞게 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: The response treats code as evidence of current behavior, surfaces the decision-level conflict, and leaves project knowledge unchanged pending explicit clarification of intent.
expectations: It does not infer that the code proves the contract was intentionally superseded.
It does not treat the request to align documentation with code as confirmation of the decision implied by code.
It reports the concrete conflict between ownership and implementation.
It requests explicit clarification before changing the decision meaning.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge 플랜 모드에서 데이터 저장소를 Postgres로 확정했어. SQLite는 동시 쓰기 요구를 못 맞춰서 제외했고, 쓰기가 단일 워커로 제한될 때만 다시 검토해. 플랜에 반영해줘.
evals.expected_output: Because project writes are forbidden in plan mode, the response recognizes the qualifying decision but does not treat it as preserved or claim that docs/decisions was updated.
expectations: It recognizes the settled, reusable trade-off and its reconsideration condition.
It does not mutate project files or claim the contract was recorded.
It does not treat plan content alone as preserved project knowledge.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge 날짜와 시간의 저장 형식처럼 이후 작업을 계속 구속하는 선택은 앞으로 네가 맡아. 이 서비스는 여러 시간대를 지원하고 DB 비교와 정렬이 중요해. UTC 저장과 사용자 현지 시간 저장 중 정해서 이후 작업도 따르게 기록해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes explicitly delegated authority for this class of reusable decision, chooses UTC storage from the supplied constraints, and records one current subject contract with the rationale and reconsideration conditions.
expectations: It treats the explicit delegation as sufficient authority for the choice to settle.
It records the reusable UTC storage rule and the multi-time-zone comparison rationale.
It preserves the plausible local-time alternative only to the extent needed to prevent the same evaluation from recurring.
It adds one index entry without duplicating the decision.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge Android 번들에 127.0.0.1이 박혀서 앱이 서버에 못 붙었어. iOS 세션이 남긴 Metro 변환 캐시를 Android가 그대로 집어온 거였고, 캐시를 비우니 10.0.2.2로 정상 번들됐어. 검증은 이어서 마쳤는데 왜 캐시 키에 플랫폼이 안 들어가는지는 못 봤어. 제품 코드는 안 건드렸고.
evals.expected_output: The response records one follow-up item for the open root cause at docs/follow-ups/<slug>.md carrying symptom, observed evidence, suspected cause, what was tried, and a proposed next step. It does not record the cache clear itself as a separate item and does not write a decision contract for an unsettled cause.
expectations: It creates a single docs/follow-ups file named for the symptom rather than appending to a shared backlog list.
The item carries symptom, observed evidence, suspected cause, what was already tried, and a proposed next step.
It does not create or update a docs/decisions subject file for a cause that is only suspected.
It does not record the completed cache clear as its own follow-up item.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge 빌드가 깨졌던 건 lock 파일을 다시 생성해서 해결했어. 원인도 확인했고 이번 커밋에 수정까지 같이 들어갔어. 남은 건 없어.
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes a fully resolved in-scope action and records no follow-up item, explaining why it does not qualify.
expectations: It does not create a docs/follow-ups file for work that closed inside the session.
It states why the resolved action does not meet the capture criteria.
It does not create a decision contract or glossary entry for the fix.

evals.prompt: /project-knowledge docs/follow-ups/metro-cache-platform-leak.md 에 적어둔 캐시 키 문제, 방금 Metro 설정에서 플랫폼을 캐시 키에 넣어서 고쳤고 두 플랫폼 다 확인했어. 이 후속 작업은 끝났어.
evals.expected_output: The response deletes the resolved follow-up file and leaves Git history as the only archive, without creating an archive copy or a status-annotated record.
expectations: It removes the resolved docs/follow-ups file rather than marking it resolved in place.
It does not create an archive folder or a superseded copy of the item.
It evaluates separately whether the resolved cause is a settled reusable decision instead of promoting it automatically.
